title: Principal at Technology Consulting Firm Sees Enterprise Buyers Cautious on Samsara AI Rollouts Despite Fleet Safety Opportunity
expert: Principal at a technology consulting firm covering seven enterprise fleet accounts of 10,000–25,000 assets each
verdict: Prices on the expert's seven enterprise accounts are up 9%–15% y/y, but activity grew only 3%–4% normalized and the Nov–Jan pipeline is flat as buyers wait for AI ROI proof.

Enterprise expansion ($100K+ cohort): 🔴 Nov 2026–Jan 2027 pipeline flat; rollouts stall before eight-figure contracts, vs 2026-11-09 consultant (pipeline modestly above plan): conflicting. → Tenet 1 (enterprise expansion) ↓
GM/FCF through component cycle: 🟢 Prices +9%–15% y/y, +3%–7% q/q, vs 2026-11-06 VP +3%–5% (higher) and 2026-11-06 MSP director +15%–20% (in range). → Tenet 3 (op leverage vs hardware cost) ↑
Competition & share: 🔴 Losing price-led GPS bids to Motive, Geotab and Verizon Connect, vs Jefferies aggressive-price competitors (SB #62604): confirming. → Tenet 4 (platform moat) ↓
